column1: # Free-text license names and URLs -> SPDX expression.  Columns (TAB separated):
#   kind (name|url)   raw text as found in POMs   SPDX expression   [ambiguous]
# Keys are normalised at load time with the same rules as lookups (SpdxNormalizer), so write
# them as they appear in the wild. Seeded from real dependency POMs (Spring Boot sample, a
# license-diverse sample, /tmp/rev/edge; see docs/LLD.md 5) plus common Maven Central variants.
# "ambiguous" marks family names without a version/variant: mapped to the most common Java
# ecosystem variant (category is the same for every variant) and flagged in evidence.
